whyMatters: Understanding System design is essential for performing Robotics responsibilities effectively.
youWillLearn: Apply System design in practical scenarios
prerequisites: Understanding of preceding topics in this roadmap
overview.outcome: You will be able to apply System design knowledge in real Robotics work and discuss it confidently.

details.whyLearn: System design is a core skill for Robotics — interviewers and teams expect competence here.
objectives: Be ready to discuss it in interviews

practice.title: Worked design problem: System design
steps: Pick a realistic component, system, or case that exercises System design.
Complete the governing calculations by hand using a simulator (LTspice/MATLAB/Vivado) or a bench setup with instruments — state assumptions and units at every step.
Check the result against a reference, code clause, or simulation and reconcile any difference.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on System design for Robotics. Finish it by checking that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply System design
projects.description: Apply System design for Robotics and produce a schematic and its simulated or measured results. Then check that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of System design by producing a schematic and its simulated or measured results and verifying that calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
requirements: A schematic and its simulated or measured results that genuinely applies System design for Robotics.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: calculated and simulated values agree within tolerance, with deviations explained.
outcomes: Working schematic, plots, and a test/measurement log.
A short written explanation of System design you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.

interviewQuestions: Explain System design to a beginner in simple terms.
Why does System design matter for a robotics?
What is a common mistake people make with System design?
details.careerRelevance: Directly relevant to Robotics — expect this in interviews and daily work.
commonMistakes: Not building things as you go
tips: Practice a little every day

Build something real with every topic
